summary: Tectonic Therapeutic filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held June 8, 2026. Items voted included election of directors (Timothy A. Springer and Stefan Vitorovic as Class II directors), ratification of Deloitte Touche LLP as auditor, and advisory approval of executive compensation. Additionally, the company issued a press release announcing completion of enrollment in the TX45 APEX Phase 2 clinical trial in PH-HFpEF patients. This filing contains routine annual meeting results and a clinical trial update, with no special-situations event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. The filing is a standard current report; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is present.
